title: Give every qualified Zedu sales opportunity a clear stage and next action
description: Define a practical institutional sales pipeline after a lead becomes qualified: qualification, demo, pilot, procurement, won and lost. Deliver entry/exit criteria, required evidence, a named owner/backup, next-action dates and an aggregate weekly report template. Test the rules with synthetic cases including duplicate leads, stalled procurement and explicit rejection. Done when the team approves the stage dictionary and the report can identify overdue actions without exposing personal details. Reuse existing signup attribution and demo forms; do not rebuild analytics or contact lists. No CRM installation, customer messaging or invented pipeline totals.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Build the stage rules into a free shared tracker with validation and stale-deal flags
acceptedWorkstreams.description: A stage dictionary only works if the tracker enforces it. Approach: a spreadsheet template (Google Sheets or Excel) with one row per opportunity, drop-downs for stage, required-evidence columns that must be filled before a stage can change, a next-action date column that turns red when it passes, and a summary tab that produces the weekly report automatically. Test it with the goal's synthetic cases (duplicates, stale deals, missing owner). Done: the template, a filled synthetic example, and a two-paragraph how-to for the sales owner.
